title: [DEV] ComboV2 needs BLUETOOTH_ADMIN permission to pair under Android 13
body:
I expect that the second pair stage (entering the 10 digit code) will not happen due to a missed permission in Bluetooth area.

including 
`<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.BLUETOOTH_ADMIN" />`
into Manifest, brings it back to work.

Android 13 (Pixel 7 Pro), DEV 3.2.0-J

comments.body: I see it in manifest. Where is missing?
This is from May, maybe it was coming in in between. When it is in, then it could be closed.
